The verdict is unchanged; the pair has been added to a packet for expert review (not yet sent).

We doubt our own "disagreement" verdict on red meat / type 2 diabetes: one paper is about unprocessed red meat and the other about red meat in general, which may not be the same exposure. The verdict is unchanged; the pair has been added to a packet for expert review (not yet sent).
